Column: bench.customers.tags
Type: ARRAY<TEXT> (list: contains(tags, x), contains_any / contains_all(tags, [...]), length(tags); its elements are tags.value)
Sample values: ["vip", "eu", "newsletter", "partner", "trial", "nordic", "alpine", "wholesale"]

SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  WHERE
    CASE
      WHEN customers.tags IS NULL OR 'vip' IS NULL
      THEN NULL
      ELSE LIST_CONTAINS([__slayer_e FOR __slayer_e IN customers.tags IF __slayer_e IS NOT NULL], 'vip')
    END
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum_partition_by"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  WHERE
    CASE
      WHEN customers.tags IS NULL OR 'vip' IS NULL
      THEN NULL
      ELSE LIST_CONTAINS([__slayer_e FOR __slayer_e IN customers.tags IF __slayer_e IS NOT NULL], 'vip')
    END
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name",
  _base."orders.revenue",
  _base."orders.revenue" / NULLIF(_cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by."orders.amount_sum_partition_by", 0) AS "orders.share"
FROM _base
CROSS JOIN _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by
ORDER BY
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name" ASC
LIMIT 100
